mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the past month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 2 months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 70% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 3 months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when HOUST decreases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% QoQ during a late-cycle expansion.
